name: befriend
code: Person a = new Person("anna"), b = new Person("ben"); Network.befriend(a, b); Network.befriend(b, a); Network.befriend(a, a); return a.friends.size() + " " + b.friends.size() + " " + b.friends.get(0).name;

name: reach
code: Person a = new Person("a"), b = new Person("b"), c = new Person("c"), d = new Person("d"), e = new Person("e"); Network.befriend(a, b); Network.befriend(b, c); Network.befriend(c, d); Network.befriend(d, b); return Network.canReach(a, d) + " " + Network.canReach(d, a) + " " + Network.canReach(a, e) + " " + Network.canReach(e, e);
message: Remember who you have visited, or the search runs in circles (StackOverflowError).
messageDe: Merke dir, wen du besucht hast, sonst läuft die Suche im Kreis (StackOverflowError).

name: distance
code: Person a = new Person("a"), b = new Person("b"), c = new Person("c"), d = new Person("d"), e = new Person("e"); Network.befriend(a, b); Network.befriend(b, c); Network.befriend(c, d); Network.befriend(a, e); Network.befriend(e, d); return Network.distance(a, a) + " " + Network.distance(a, b) + " " + Network.distance(a, d) + " " + Network.distance(b, d) + " " + Network.distance(a, new Person("x"));
message: Shortest chain: anna → eve → dan has length 2 even though anna → ben → carla → dan also exists.
messageDe: Kürzeste Kette: anna → eve → dan hat Länge 2, auch wenn es anna → ben → carla → dan gibt.
